entities.summary: His Excellency. The Most Reverend. Monsignor. Gustavo Oscar Carrara is a prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He has been appointed as Metropolitan Archbishop-designate of La Plata in Argentina. He has served as an auxiliary bishop of Buenos Aires since 2017 to 2024.
